content.title: 2024 Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Guideline
content.overview: The guideline covers assessment of sudden cardiac death risk related to hypertrophic cardiomyopathy including screening strategies, imaging techniques, and clinical evaluations.

genes.context: Natural history of genotype-positive phenotype-negative patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. J Am Coll Cardiol. 2011;57: 258–259.
